title: Monster dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- Body -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='20' ry='22' fill='#7bbf3a'/>
    <!-- Belly patch -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='12' ry='14' fill='#b7e37a'/>
    <!-- Head -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='16' fill='#7bbf3a'/>
    <!-- Horns -->
    <polygon points='39,18 36,6 46,15' fill='#f2c14e'/>
    <polygon points='61,18 64,6 54,15' fill='#f2c14e'/>
    <!-- Eyes -->
    <circle cx='44' cy='28' r='4' fill='#fff5cc'/>
    <circle cx='56' cy='28' r='4' fill='#fff5cc'/>
    <circle cx='44' cy='28' r='2' fill='#3a2a6b'/>
    <circle cx='56' cy='28' r='2' fill='#3a2a6b'/>
    <!-- Mouth -->
    <path d='M42 36 Q50 44 58 36' stroke='#3a2a6b' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- Teeth -->
    <polygon points='46,37 48,42 50,37' fill='#fffbe6'/>
    <polygon points='52,37 54,42 56,37' fill='#fffbe6'/>
    <!-- Left arm up (dancing) -->
    <path d='M32 52 Q20 44 18 32' stroke='#7bbf3a' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- Left hand -->
    <circle cx='17' cy='30' r='5' fill='#9fe05a'/>
    <!-- Right arm down/out -->
    <path d='M68 56 Q80 62 84 72' stroke='#7bbf3a' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='85' cy='74' r='5' fill='#9fe05a'/>
    <!-- Left leg kicking up -->
    <path d='M42 82 Q34 88 26 84' stroke='#67a82e' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <ellipse cx='24' cy='84' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#a5d95c'/>
    <!-- Right leg standing -->
    <path d='M58 82 Q62 90 64 92' stroke='#67a82e' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <ellipse cx='66' cy='93' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#a5d95c'/>
    <!-- Spots -->
    <circle cx='38' cy='58' r='3' fill='#4f8a20'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='66' r='3' fill='#4f8a20'/>
    <circle cx='55' cy='76' r='2.5' fill='#4f8a20'/>
  </g>
</svg>
